Observability

Fenêtre de déploiement

A predefined, scheduled time period during which changes, deployments, or updates are allowed to be released to production systems, minimizing operational risk and ensuring oversight.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Fenêtre de déploiement?

In this glossary, Fenêtre de déploiement refers to: A predefined, scheduled time period during which changes, deployments, or updates are allowed to be released to production systems, minimizing operational risk and ensuring oversight.

How is Fenêtre de déploiement used in IT and DevOps?

In IT and DevOps communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tous les changements majeurs d’application doivent être déployés dans une fenêtre de déploiement approuvée pour éviter les perturbations aux heures de pointe."

Why does Fenêtre de déploiement matter in IT and DevOps?

Fenêtre de déploiement matters because it supports clear communication in Observability contexts for DevOps Engineers, SREs, and Platform Engineers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as AWS Certification, Azure Certification, ITIL v4, and CKA/CKAD.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from ITIL v4, AWS Well-Architected Framework, Kubernetes Documentation, CNCF and published by Protermify IT/DevOps as a static IT and DevOps reference page.

Definition

A predefined, scheduled time period during which changes, deployments, or updates are allowed to be released to production systems, minimizing operational risk and ensuring oversight.

Operational example

All major application changes must be deployed within an approved release window to avoid peak usage disruptions.

Localized term

Fenêtre de déploiement

Localized example

Tous les changements majeurs d’application doivent être déployés dans une fenêtre de déploiement approuvée pour éviter les perturbations aux heures de pointe.
